3280575: Does the BOH manager on site know how to access HACCP?
Does the BOH manager on site know where to find employee hygiene and allergen certificates?
Have all food handlers completed the FSA Allergen Training and Food Safety Level 2 (Scotland)?
Are all high-risk deliveries recorded daily? (Example: raw fish, frozen goods)
Are hot holding temperatures recorded daily?
Are rice pH levels recorded daily?
Are all fridge and freezer temperatures recorded daily?
Are all staff wearing suitable uniforms which are clean and in good condition?
Were team members observed using good personal hygiene practices?
Are correct facilities provided at wash hand basins (antibacterial soap, sanitising gel, and disposable paper roll)?
Are wash hand basins free from obstruction?
Are staff food/drinks labelled and stored in a way that prevents cross-contamination in the kitchen?
Are staff personal belongings stored in a way that prevents cross-contamination in the kitchen (e.g. coats, jumpers, trainers, mobile phones)?
Are all food items appropriately labelled and within date? (3 out-of-date labels = auto fail)
Are all food items stored correctly (no food/containers stored on the floor)?
Is all food adequately covered and protected from contamination during storage?
Are colour-coded chopping boards available and being used correctly?
Are chilled and frozen foods stored in an orderly manner allowing for effective stock rotation?
Are raw foods and ‘ready-to-eat’ foods stored in a manner to prevent cross-contamination?
Is allergen information provided and up to date?
Are all sinks labelled and used for designated purposes only?
Are sanitisers used correctly for all work and food contact surfaces?
Are disposable cleaning materials used to clean surfaces?
Are all chemicals approved for use around food, bottles clearly labelled, and correctly dispensed?
Are chemicals stored safely to prevent unauthorised use and contain spillages?
Are cleaning schedules completed and cleaning carried out as stated?
Is the kitchen maintained in a clean condition (walls, floors, ceilings, extraction hoods)? Weekly deep clean evident?
Are bins maintained in clean condition and regularly emptied?
Are storage areas (dry storage, shelving, cupboards, etc.) kept in a clean condition?
Are ceilings maintained in a sound, easy-to-clean condition?
Are walls maintained in a sound, easy-to-clean condition and good repair? (No damaged tiles, flaking paint, holes, etc.)
Are floors maintained in good repair and easy to clean?
Are doors and frames maintained in a sound, easy-to-clean condition?
Is adequate lighting provided to all work areas and fittings in good repair?
Is drainage sufficient and well maintained?
Are all sinks and wash hand basins maintained in good working order with hot & cold running water?
Are probe wipes available to clean the probes?
Are preparation surfaces smooth, impervious, and in good repair for effective sanitising?
Are all fridges, freezers, and temperature control equipment maintained and operating correctly?
Is all high-risk equipment (ice machine, gas hobs, rice cooker, etc.) in good condition?
Is all low-risk equipment (scales, dishwasher, microwave, etc.) in good condition?
Is refuse stored hygienically and changed regularly to prevent buildup?
Are all areas free from any signs of pest activity?
Are insectocutors (electric fly killing units) clean and switched on?
Is there no buildup or storage of redundant equipment on site or in the kitchen?
3280545: Do all the tare have the correct spoons? (red spoons, 14cc soy ladle, long teaspoon in chilli oil)
Does the section have 3 whisks? (1 vegan, 1 non-vegan, chicken)
Is the garlic fresh and good quality?
Check the quality of the spring onions , are they cut properly, not bruised or too old, and not stuck together like a string?
Check the wakame , has it been prepped to recipe and is the quality good?
Are the bamboo shoots fresh (not sour, slimy, or with any odour)?
Is the tofu prepared properly (fried, marinated, sliced with the middle still white)?
Is the coconut milk fresh (not off, sour, or spoiled)?
Is the charsui round and held together (not broken or open; check stock if broken)?
Has the egg been cooked properly (softness, yolk check)?
Is the salmon fresh (no smell, not slimy or tacky to the touch)?
Has the beef been cooked properly (pink in the middle, cut properly , not too thick or too thin)?
Is cucumber fresh (not slimy, wet, or old)?
Have rice noodles been soaked and are they ready to use?
Is the pak choi clean, washed, and prepped properly (nice individual leaves)?
Has the broth been blended properly (no fat floating, not discoloured)?
Is the veg broth of good quality , has dashi been used, enough flavour (not just water)?
Check the tempura quality (fluffy, well cooked, not dark on first fry).
Ensure tempura batter has been prepared correctly (no lumps, not too thick or thin, custard consistency).
Make sure the spicy teriyaki isn’t a full bowl (chefs should add a little at a time).
Bain marie , ensure everything is hot, working properly, taste miso and curry for correct prep
Make sure karaage is not pre-cooked (fry only once).
Check tofu for miso soup (fresh, not sour or slimy, not falling apart).
Taste potatoes and carrots (not overcooked, still fresh, properly cut, not squishy or slimy).
Make sure donburi rice is cut properly (fluffy, not the shape of the rice cooker).
Has the takoyaki cooked in a good condition, not broken?
Check the plates in window fridges , have they been changed over? (No water present.)
Daikon , ensure available and of good quality (fresh, crunchy, nice colour, not soft or slimy).
Tamago , plate clean and dry, not soggy, taste for quality.
Check freshness of fish in windows , all proteins still fresh.
Eel , sliced properly (4 fingers x 2 fingers).
Salmon and tuna nigiri , cut correctly (4 fingers x 2 fingers).
Prawn , not rubbery/overcooked, correct size (4 fingers x 2 fingers).
Check raw fish storage , separate from or below RTE foods.
Spicy tuna , taste for quality, seasoning, flavour; ensure recipe followed.
Does the section have adequate par levels (enough prep for smooth service)?
Garlic salt , 50/50 ratio, available, prepared properly.
Avocado scales , green dragon roll topping correct (green, not brown; slices thin and even).
Taste the rice and ask about vinegar ratio/pH level.
3317209: Is the outside of the restaurant clean and tidy?
Is Irrashaimase being done inline with the Maki and Ramen standard?
BOH and Sushi not fully co-operating
Are guests being asked about allergies and dietary requirements when seated?
Is the floor clean, free of debris and marks?
Is the Taiko Drum being hit twice at the correct tempo and volume level, inline with the Irrashaimase?
Are the allergen sheets up to date, clean and presentable?
Are the food and drinks menu's clean and presentable?
Are the table talks promotional materials clean and presentable?
Is there the correct number of place settings?
Are the napkins neatly folded and placed central of the place setting?
Are the chopsticks lay central of the napkin, facing from the right side inwards?
Is there a full soy sauce bottle and the correct number ramekins on the table?
Is the table clean free of without debris or dirty marks?
Are the seats/booths clean, free of debris and marks?
Is the lighting in the site suitable?
Is the temperature of the restaurant comfortable?
Is the music suitable and playing at an appropriate volume level?
Are all reflective surfaces clean and polished?
Is the floor clean, free of debris and marks?
Is the sticky note wall tidy and free from inappropriate notes?
Are the management dressed appropriately? (Smart casual)
Are the FOH staff in uniform? Is the uniform clean and presentable?
Are the BAR staff in uniform? Is the uniform clean and presentable?
Do all staff meet hygiene standards? (Hair tied up, clean uniforms etc)
Is the bar area tidy and clutter free?
Is the glassware clean and polished?
Are there date labels on fruit, juices, egg whites/OGGS, purees etc?
Is the stock room clean and tidy?
Is the glass washer clean and the correct chemicals in use?
Have the beer lines been cleaned?
Is there visible organisation to the stock?
Is there a stock rotation system in place? (FIFO)
Is the in use toilet roll triangled off?
Is the toilet paper stocked up properly?
Are the toilet stalls clean and debris free?
Are the correct type(s) of fire extinguisher available (CO₂, foam, wet chemical for kitchens).
Are they located in visible, accessible areas
Are they Inspected and serviced within the last 12 months.
is there Staff trained in proper use.
Smoke/heat detectors installed in key areas (kitchen, dining, storage).
Fire alarm panel operational and tested Regurlarly?
Clearly marked and illuminated exit signs.
Exits unobstructed and doors open outward.
Fire blanket available near cooking areas.
Grease filters and ducting cleaned regularly.
Fire drills conducted at least annually.
Fire safety policy displayed and understood.
No overloaded sockets or exposed wiring.
Flammable materials stored safely away from heat.
Waste disposed of regularly, no blockages..
Alcohol license up to date and displayed correctly
Insurance coverage (public liability, employer’s liability) up to date and displayed correctly
Weights and measures act is displayed
All staff have licensing training comlpeted and on file
Are menus clean and undamaged , no stains, tears, peeling laminate, or faded print? How many are in circulation vs. how many are needed for the seating capacity?
Check implemented after audit visit - will all be marked as "yes" this month
Are allergen and dietary markings present, legible, and matching the current allergen matrix?
Are all table talkers, counter cards, and posters for current campaigns and offers only , nothing expired (e.g. a promotion that finished last month)? Photo of each distinct piece.
Do QR codes on tables and materials scan correctly and land on the right destination (loyalty, ordering, reviews)?
Are window vinyls, A-boards, and external signage current, intact, and clean, with the correct opening hours displayed? Photo of the frontage from the street.
Do digital screens, till-facing displays, and the Deliveroo/online menus show the current products, prices, and imagery, with no sold-out or delisted items still live?
Does the site have a stock of spares (menus, table talkers) for replacements, and is old material stored or disposed of rather than left out?
3326602: Is Irrashaimase being done inline with the Maki and Ramen standard?
Is the Taiko Drum being hit twice at the correct tempo and volume level, inline with the Irrashaimase?
Is Onegaishimase being said by Kitchen and Bar Pass
Are staff thanking customers when leaving?
Are all staff in correct uniform?
Do all staff meet hygiene standards? (Hair tied up, clean uniforms etc)
